data.body: A2-2 RED oracle established at base 5892134975. Contract cards: (1) normal cutover: mixed inline/sidecar store -> BindingStore.save -> sidecar holds chronological max, bindings retain all unrelated fields but no inline stamps, reload order exact; (2) fail-open recovery: inject get_rotation tempfile failure -> primary save retains newest inline floor, reload exact, clean retry converges sidecar-only; (3) crash boundary: inject bindings os.replace failure after sidecar boundary -> bindings bytes unchanged, newest max already durable in sidecar, reload/retry converges; (4) real-git commit boundary -> one commit contains scrubbed bindings plus max sidecar and clean worktree. Six selected new/strengthened nodes collected/executed with no skip/xfail and failed for intended behavior absence: 6 failed in 1.70s (five legacy-field assertions, one bindings-first crash-max assertion). Existing anti-starvation test remains the green regression guard; packed cost is a post-GREEN repository measurement. Surface census: CLI no direct surface (reconciler internal); MCP/API and public library out of scope (no binding-store surface); automated reconciler caller in scope via real commit boundary; dual-direction in scope through old-writer/new-writer max migration. Contention suite exempt: one established save boundary, no new lock/retry/cache layer.
